title: $H^p$ spaces in the Dunkl setting meet Coifman--Weiss--type atoms
summary: Let $Δ_k$ be the Dunkl Laplacian associated with an arbitrary root system and a nonnegative multiplicity function. For every $0<p\leq1$, a Coifman-Weiss type atomic characterization of the Hardy space $H^p_{\mathrm{Dunkl}}$ is established.
